vfbconnectr 0.1.0
  • Reference

Return reference to VfbConnect object

Source: R/vfb_connect.R
VfbConnect.Rd

Return reference to VfbConnect object

Usage

VfbConnect(..., raw = FALSE, cache = TRUE)

Arguments

...

Additional arguments passed to Python's `VfbConnect`. See examples.

raw

Whether to return python list containing raw JSON (default FALSE)

cache

Whether to cache the VfbConnect object (default T since this can save some time).

Value

An list containing the processed results or (when raw=TRUE) as python list containing raw JSON.

Details

See https://pypi.org/project/vfb-connect/. The raw=TRUE option is mostly useful to see what output would look like.

Examples


vc=VfbConnect()
# large return, so use str
str(vc$neo_query_wrapper$get_type_TermInfo(list('FBbt_00003686')), max=2)
#> 'data.frame':	1 obs. of  8 variables:
#>  $ label        : chr "Kenyon cell"
#>  $ symbol       : chr "KC"
#>  $ id           : chr "FBbt_00003686"
#>  $ tags         :List of 1
#>   ..$ : chr  "Entity" "Anatomy" "Cell" "Class" ...
#>  $ data_source  :List of 1
#>   ..$ : list()
#>  $ accession    :List of 1
#>   ..$ : list()
#>  $ parents_label:List of 1
#>   ..$ : chr  "anterior ectoderm derivative" "anterior ectoderm derivative" "anterior ectoderm derivative" "anterior ectoderm derivative" ...
#>  $ parents_id   :List of 1
#>   ..$ : chr  "FBbt_00025991" "FBbt_00025991" "FBbt_00025991" "FBbt_00025991" ...
#>  - attr(*, "pandas.index")=RangeIndex(start=0, stop=1, step=1)
# do this to explore
# vc$neo_query_wrapper$get_type_TermInfo(list('FBbt_00003686')) %>% View()
vc$neo_query_wrapper$get_type_TermInfo(list('FBbt_00003686'), summary=TRUE)
#>         label symbol            id
#> 1 Kenyon cell     KC FBbt_00003686
#>                                                                              tags
#> 1 Entity, Anatomy, Cell, Class, Nervous_system, Neuron, has_subClass, hasScRNAseq
#>   data_source accession
#> 1        NULL      NULL
#>
